binance-web3 v1.0.0

- Initial release of the Query Token Info skill by binance-web3-team.
- Enables searching for tokens by name, symbol, or contract address across BSC, Base, and Solana chains.
- Provides APIs to retrieve token metadata (details, social links, creator, description).
- Offers real-time market data: price, price trend, volume, holders, liquidity, and market cap.
- Supports fetching K-Line candlestick (OHLCV) charts for technical analysis.
